about_the_game:
Long Live the Emperor is a strategy simulation game where you rule an ancient Chinese dynasty, govern the nation, expand your empire, and ensure your bloodline endures. As long as the emperor lives and the treasury is full, the dynasty will stand!

Highlight Features:

High Degree of Freedom, Define a Unique Character
You can personally shape the appearance of your own character. From the details of facial features to the matching of headdresses and costumes, fully showcase your creativity and aesthetic taste, allowing the character to blend into this grand journey of dynastic power struggles in a unique way.

A Thousand People, a Thousand Faces, Distinctive NPCs
From loyal ministers to scheming powerful officials, from graceful concubines to high-spirited common scholars, every NPC has a unique appearance and background story. Their existence not only makes the world more vivid but also sets the stage for every choice you make.

Exquisitely Painted, Soul-Stirring CG Events
The game features more than 200 exquisitely detailed CG events. Every scene is carefully designed, enabling you to enjoy visual satisfaction while engaging in strategic battles.

Core Gameplay:

Appoint Officials

Strengthen the Nation Select and manage officials, reward loyalty,develop industries,and secure funds for war or suppressing noble clans.

Support Scholars

Weaken Nobles Recruit scholars through imperial exams, arrange strategic marriages,and impeach corrupt ministers to restore imperial authority.

Select Consorts

Continue the Bloodline Marry talented consorts and raise heirs who inherit their parents’traits. Protect them from assassination and help them gain a foothold in court.

Expand Territory

Conquer Enemies Lead armies to battle foreign invaders, seize resources, and expand your empire’s dominance.

Dynastic Succession,

Eternal Legacy Prepare for succession by balancing noble factions, securing loyal ministers, and stabilizing diplomacy to ensure a lasting empire.

short_description: You'll time-travel to a turbulent ancient Chinese dynasty as a young monarch. Ascend the throne amidst chaos and navigate among powerful officials, noble clans, and common scholars. Each vermilion note harbors danger. Your choice will shape history: Create a prosperous era or be a fallen king.
